land.text: the state as it stood in 1870, unchanged to November 1918 (Free State of Anhalt)

successors.note: The state was a federal state of the German Empire from 1871 and ended in November 1918 (see the dissolve event); the Weimar Republic took over its land (Free State of Anhalt). The German Empire was its overlord, not its successor, so it is no longer listed here (fx-53 D01, was the 1871 dissolve into german-empire; same change as fx-46 R122 for Bavaria); the hierarchy.csv row duchy-of-anhalt -> german-empire (constituent, 1871-1918) is for the orchestrator.

rulers.title: Duke of Anhalt
rulers.note: Infobox '1863-1871: Leopold IV (first)' of the united duchy. Before 1863 three dukes ruled the three duchies (Bernburg: Alexius Frederick Christian to 1834, Alexander Karl 1834-1863; Köthen: Henry 1830-1847; Dessau: the page lists Leopold III to 1807 only), not a single list.

keyframe_review.note: 1,683 km2 for 1806-1808: the three duchies together. The Duchy page gives 3,800 km2 in the infobox (no year) and 906 sq mi (2,300 km2) in the text for 'the former duchy' (1863-1918); the ratio is 0.73 against the text and 0.44 against the infobox, within a factor of two of the text. Page: 'In 1806, Napoleon elevated the remaining states of Anhalt-Bernburg, Anhalt-Dessau and Anhalt-Köthen to duchies'; all three joined the Confederation of the Rhine on 11 April 1807 (Confederation page).

1,727 km2 for 1809-1813: 44 km2 more than 1806-1808. The Bernburg page: Anhalt-Zeitz-Hoym 'was reunited with Anhalt-Bernburg in 1812' (infobox: 'partitioned away: 1718-1812'), which would be a rise in 1812, not 1809; the page gives no area for Hoym. Cliopatria's step is three years early or from another cause; kept.

1,552 km2 for 1814-1819: 175 km2 below 1809-1813 and 438 km2 below 1820. No page opened records a loss in 1814 or a gain in 1820 (the Duchy page has no exchange with Prussia; it describes only 'five enclaves surrounded by Prussian territory'). Unverified: page budget. Suspected digitisation difference; the same 1,552 km2 outline reappears in 1866-1867.

1,990 km2 for 1820-1863, the largest shape. Against the Duchy page's 2,300 km2 (text) the ratio is 0.87; against the infobox's 3,800 km2 it is 0.52, both within a factor of two. The union of the lines in 1863 ('These duchies were united in 1863 to form a united Anhalt again') changes no border.
1,902 km2 for 1864-1865, 88 km2 below 1820-1863 with no event on the pages: unverified: page budget. The united duchy of 1863 is the same land as the three duchies.

1,552 km2 for 1866-1867, the 1814 outline again: no page records a loss; the Austro-Prussian War page lists Prussian annexations of Hanover, Holstein, Schleswig, Hesse-Kassel, Nassau and Frankfurt and none of Anhalt. Unverified: page budget; the 1868 outline (1,990 km2) is probably the right one for 1866-1867.
1,990 km2 for 1870, the last Cliopatria shape.
New keyframe: 1871, the state's closing year in the sibling German-state dossiers; the 1870 outline unchanged. The duchy lasted to 1918 inside the empire ('Duchy of Anhalt (1863-1918)').

region.text: the three duchies of Bernburg, Dessau and Köthen, about 2,300 km2 by the Duchy page's text

ledger.note: 1806: Napoleon elevates the three Anhalt lines to duchies. 'In 1806, Napoleon elevated the remaining states of Anhalt-Bernburg, Anhalt-Dessau and Anhalt-Köthen to duchies.' The lines' own pages differ: Anhalt-Köthen 'Raised to duchy: 1806', Anhalt-Dessau 'Raised to duchy: 1807', Anhalt-Bernburg 'Raised to duchy: 1803' and 'In 1806, the Act of the Confederation of the Rhine elevated it to a duchy'; all three joined the Confederation of the Rhine on 11 April 1807.

region.text: Anhalt-Zeitz-Hoym, a line partitioned away 1718-1812 (the radius is a placement)

ledger.note: 1812: Anhalt-Zeitz-Hoym is reunited with Anhalt-Bernburg. 'Anhalt-Zeitz-Hoym partitioned away: 1718-1812'; 'reunited with Anhalt-Bernburg in 1812'. The page gives no area; Cliopatria's step of 44 km2 comes in 1809.

region.text: the territories of the Anhalt-Köthen line

ledger.note: 22 May 1853: Anhalt-Köthen is united with Anhalt-Dessau. The Köthen line had become extinct with Duke Henry on 23 November 1847; 'Officially merged with Anhalt-Dessau: 22 May 1853'; 'All territories passed to Duke Leopold IV of Anhalt-Dessau' and, on the Dessau page, 'by Patent of 22 May 1853'. An internal union: the union of the lines changes no outline.

region.text: the territories of the Anhalt-Bernburg line

ledger.note: 19 August 1863: the last Duke of Anhalt-Bernburg dies and the duchy is reunited. The Dessau page: 'Following the death of the last Duke of Anhalt-Bernburg on 19 August 1863'; the Duchy page: 'These duchies were united in 1863 to form a united Anhalt again due to the extinction of the Köthen and Bernburg lines'; Leopold IV becomes Duke of Anhalt. An internal union.

region.text: the state's outline as it stood in 1870, unchanged to November 1918

ledger.note: November 1918: the duchy ends in the German Revolution. The Duchy page gives the year only ('In 1918, Anhalt became a state within the Weimar Republic'; infobox 'German Revolution: 1918', succeeded by the Free State of Anhalt) and no abdication day; the month rests on the revolution page: 'By the end of the month, the dynastic rulers of all the other German states had abdicated without bloodshed' (German revolution of 1918-1919 page). Infobox status 'State of the German Empire'. Federal state of the German Empire from 1871 ('The other states retained their own governments but had only limited aspects of sovereignty', German Empire page). Was a dissolve in 1871 into german-empire; moved to November 1918 and the counterpart changed to weimar-republic on the 3 Nov 2026 fix (fx-53 D01, as fx-46 R122 did for Bavaria): the Empire was this state's overlord, not its successor.

certainty.note: A small state with administrative boundaries; the Duchy page notes 'five enclaves surrounded by Prussian territory' (Alsleben, Mühlingen, Dornburg, Gödnitz, Tilkerode-Abberode), whose outline Cliopatria may not draw. 1872-1918 (fx-53): the dossier records no frontier change after 1871; the state keeps its 1870 outline as a federal state of the German Empire.

notes: ONE STATE OR THREE? Cliopatria's single 'Duchy of Anhalt' row (1806-1870) covers three sovereign duchies (Bernburg, Dessau, Köthen) until their union in 1863; the Wikipedia article 'Duchy of Anhalt' describes only the united duchy of 1863-1918. This dossier follows the principality-of-anhalt dossier of batch eu-09-x, which kept all lines in one state and handed it to this one in 1806: one state, one colour, with the dynastic unions of 1853 (Köthen into Dessau) and 1863 (Bernburg) as merge events that change no outline. The three lines have no dossiers of their own; a gap-filler could add Anhalt-Dessau, Anhalt-Bernburg and Anhalt-Köthen if the project wants them drawn as separate states. END: Cliopatria's row stops in 1870; the duchy stayed a state of the German Empire until 1918 (Duchy page: 1863-1918). The dossier closes in January 1871 like the sibling German-state dossiers (Brunswick, Mecklenburg, Bavaria, Saxony), with a new 1871 keyframe, and the dissolve event is confidence 1 because the pages opened do not date Anhalt's entry into the empire. DISAGREEMENTS: the duchy's start is 1806 (Duchy and Köthen pages), 1807 (Dessau page) or 1803 and 1806 (Bernburg page). The Bernburg page's 'Anhalt-Köthen-Plötzkau fell to Anhalt-Bernburg in 1847' and the Dessau page's Köthen succession of 1853 are internal. UNEXPLAINED SHAPES: the 1,552 km2 outline in 1814-1819 and 1866-1867 (22 percent below the 1,990 km2 of its neighbours), the +44 km2 step of 1809 (Hoym is 1812) and the -88 km2 step of 1864-1865; no page opened explains them (page budget, five pages); they are verdict ok with 'unverified'. NOT ON ANY PAGE: any territorial exchange with Prussia (the Duchy page names the enclaves Alsleben and Mühlingen but dates no exchange), the Zerbst inheritance of 1793 for the Dessau line (Köthen page: 'received parts of the extinct Principality of Anhalt-Zerbst in 1793' only), the Austro-Prussian War role of Anhalt (not on the war page), the date of Anhalt's entry into the North German Confederation (1866-67) and the German Empire. WARS: none listed; the war pages opened do not name Anhalt. GAZETTEER NAMES NEEDED: 'Dessau', 'Bernburg', 'Köthen', 'Hoym' (places, near 51.8 N 11.9 E). REALM OF MEMBER STATES (fx-53 D01, 3 Nov 2026): this state now lives to November 1918 as a federal state of the German Empire, which 'retained their own governments' (German Empire page: 'The other states retained their own governments but had only limited aspects of sovereignty'; 'the Kaiser and all German ruling kings, dukes, and princes abdicated' in November 1918) and the German revolution of 1918-1919 page: 'By the end of the month, the dynastic rulers of all the other German states had abdicated without bloodshed'. Changed: identity.end 1871 -> 1918/11; the 1871 dissolve into german-empire became a 1918/11 dissolve into weimar-republic; successors german-empire -> weimar-republic; last keyframe (duchy-of-anhalt_1871) carried to 1918 ('to'); capital and certainty to 1918. The german-empire dossier no longer gains this land in 1871 nor lists the state as a predecessor, and weimar-republic lists it as a predecessor (fx-53 D02, D04). The hierarchy.csv row duchy-of-anhalt -> german-empire (constituent, 1871-1918) is for the orchestrator. The Duchy page gives the year 1918 only; November follows from the revolution page.
